We need to propose a 3-step retrosynthesis for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have hints: step 1 forward: carboxylic acid to amide (coupling). So retrosynthetic step: break amide bond to give carboxylic acid and amine.

Step 2 forward: Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (with decarboxylation). So retrosynthetic step: break C=C double bond and carboxylic acid to give aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually forward: aldehyde + malonic acid -> unsaturated acid. So reverse: unsaturated acid -> aldehyde + malonic acid (or malonic acid derivative). So we need to identify the unsaturated acid fragment in target: /C=C/C(=O)N... The unsaturated acid is part of amide? Wait target has /C=C/C(=O)N... So there is an α,β-unsaturated amide (enone amide). The Doebner modification forms α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid, not amide. But we could have first step amide formation after Doebner? Actually forward steps enumerated: 1) carboxylic acid to amide (makes amide). 2) Doebner modification (makes α,β-unsaturated acid). 3) sulfonamide formation (makes sulfonamide). So retrosynthesis order: start from target, step 1 reverse: break amide to give carboxylic acid and aniline (or amine). Step 2 reverse: break unsaturated acid to give aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. Step 3 reverse: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride and amine.

Thus we need to propose three reactions with appropriate template IDs. We need to find template IDs for these transformations. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with appropriate functional groups.

First, sulfonamide formation: forward: amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. So reverse: break sulfonamide to give amine and sulfonyl chloride. Functional groups broken: sulfonamide? Actually forward forms sulfonamide, so reverse breaks sulfonamide into sulfonyl chloride and amine. So we can search for functional_groups_broken: ["sulfonamides"] and functional_groups_formed: ["sulfonyl chloride","primary amines"]? Not sure. Let's just search for templates that involve sulfonamide formation. Use functional_groups_broken maybe "primary amines" and "sulfonyl chloride"? Let's try search with functional_groups_formed: ["sulfonamides"].
